high_yield: Risperidone Consta requires 21 days of oral overlap due to a 3-week PLGA polymer degradation lag time (StahlKids p.423, StahlNeuro p.234).
Paliperidone Sustenna loading requires Deltoid injections on Day 1 (234mg) and Day 8 (156mg), eliminating the need for oral overlap (StahlKids p.370, StahlNeuro p.234).
Paliperidone Trinza (q3m) conversion requires at least 4 months of stability on Sustenna, using a 3.5x dose multiplier (StahlKids p.370, StahlNeuro p.235).
Olanzapine Relprevv carries a Black Box warning for Post-Injection Delirium Sedation Syndrome (PDSS), requiring a 3-hour post-injection observation under REMS (StahlKids p.351, StahlNeuro p.225).
Oral tolerability testing is mandatory before administering the first LAI dose to rule out severe adverse reactions or allergies (StahlKids p.42, p.370).
Akathisia in youth is frequently misdiagnosed as worsening psychotic agitation, risking inappropriate dose escalation (DSM p.813, Dulcan p.821).
Routine prolactin monitoring in asymptomatic patients is not recommended; testing is indicated only when clinical symptoms appear (Dulcan p.835, StahlKids p.368).
AIMS examination for tardive dyskinesia must be performed at baseline, 3 months, and every 6-12 months thereafter (Dulcan p.823, Syllabus p.39).
